title: 第91章 父母来上海，大伯一家

第91章 父母来上海，大伯一家-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

十一月的上海，风已经冷了。

梧桐叶落在衡复片区的路边，车轮碾过去，声音很轻。

藏锋还在装修。

林川没有天天往现场跑。

老洋房的修缮、茶器、消防、动线，全交给苏晚棠和夏若冰对接。

苏晚棠管流程。

夏若冰管体验。

两个人一个抓大方向，一个盯细节，正好互补。

九州创投这边，叶知秋继续统筹。

张江项目推进正常。

芯海微电子二期扩产已经进场，数智云的搬迁也快收尾，几笔早期投资开始有回款。

周明远每天忙得停不下来。

张虎也跟着跑供应线，黑了不少，人却精神。

下午四点，林川刚看完太平洋桥的第二份资料，手机响了。

是家里电话。

林川接起。

“爸。”

电话那头，林建国的声音比以前松快了不少。

“川子，你妈说想去上海看看你和小冉。”

林川靠到椅背上。

“早就该来了。什么时候到？我让人订票。”

“票买好了，后天上午到虹桥。”

旁边传来母亲李秀兰的声音。

“别让他折腾，我们自己坐车过去就行。”

林建国压低声音：“你妈怕你花钱。”

林川笑了。

“来上海还能让你们自己找路？爸，你把航班发我。”

电话那头顿了顿。

林建国又说：“还有个事。”

“嗯？”

“你大伯一家也一起过来。”

林川手指停了一下。

大伯林建业，林建国的亲哥。

前世父亲最难的时候，大伯家没落井下石，但也没帮过什么忙。

态度一直很清楚。

亲戚可以认。

麻烦别沾。

尤其大伯母王桂芬，说话最讲究分寸。

她的分寸，就是让你难受，还挑不出她明着骂你。

电话那头很快换了声音。

“川子啊，我是你大伯母。”

林川语气平稳。

“大伯母。”

王桂芬笑了一声。

“听你爸说，你现在在上海做点生意？挺好。年轻人出来闯闯，总比窝在江城强。”

林川没接。

王桂芬继续说：“你堂哥林海在上海待了好几年，地方熟。到时候你要是不太清楚路，让他带带你们。上海大，消费也高，别被人坑了。”

林川看了一眼窗外。

陆家嘴的楼在玻璃上压出影子。

“好。”

王桂芬没停。

“都是一家人，不用客气。你堂哥现在也算在上海站住脚了，做外企销售，收入还可以。”

林川说：“挺好的。”

电话挂断后，林川把行程发给叶知秋。

“后天上午，虹桥接人。我父母，大伯一家，五个人。”

Chapter 91 Parents come to Shanghai, uncle’s family - "Rebirth 2000: I broke the agreement and became rich"

In Shanghai in November, the wind is already cold.

The sycamore leaves fell on the roadside in the Heng Complex Area, and the wheels rolled over them, making a very soft sound.

Zangfeng is still under renovation.

Lin Chuan didn't go to the scene every day.

The renovation of the old bungalow, tea utensils, fire protection, and circulation lines were all left to Su Wantang and Xia Ruobing.

Su Wantang is in charge of the process.

Xia Ruobing tube experience.

One of the two people focuses on the general direction and the other focuses on the details, which complement each other perfectly.

For Jiuzhou Venture Capital, Ye Zhiqiu continues to coordinate.

The Zhangjiang project is progressing normally.

The second phase of the expansion of Chipsea Microelectronics has begun, the relocation of Data Intelligence Cloud is about to be completed, and several early investments are beginning to pay off.

Zhou Mingyuan is too busy to stop every day.

Zhang Hu also followed him to run the supply line. He was a lot of trouble, but he was energetic.

At four o'clock in the afternoon, Lin Chuan had just finished reading the second information on Pacific Bridge when his cell phone rang.

It's the home phone number.

Lin Chuan picked up.

"Dad."

On the other end of the phone, Lin Jianguo's voice was much louder and faster than before.

"Kawako, your mother said she wants to visit you and Xiaoran in Shanghai."

Lin Chuan leaned back on the chair.

"It should have come a long time ago. When will it arrive? I'll have someone book a ticket."

"The tickets have been purchased and we will arrive at Hongqiao the day after tomorrow."

The voice of mother Li Xiulan came from the side.

"Don't let him bother, we can just go there by ourselves."

Lin Jianguo lowered his voice: "Your mother is afraid that you will spend money."

Lin Chuan smiled.

"Can you still find your own way to Shanghai? Dad, please send me the flight."

There was a pause on the other end of the phone.

Lin Jianguo added: "There is one more thing."

"Huh?"

"Your uncle and his family are also coming together."

Lin Chuan's fingers paused for a moment.

Uncle Lin Jianye, Lin Jianguo's brother.

When my father was in the most difficult situation in his previous life, his uncle's family didn't make matters worse, but they didn't do much to help him either.

The attitude has always been clear.

Relatives can recognize it.

Please don't touch it.

Especially the eldest aunt Wang Guifen, who is the most particular about speaking in a measured way.

Her sense of propriety is just to make you feel uncomfortable, but she can't blame you for scolding you openly.

The voice on the other end of the phone quickly changed.

"Kawako, I am your aunt."

Lin Chuan's tone was calm.

"Auntie."

Wang Guifen laughed.

"I heard from your dad that you are doing some business in Shanghai now? That's good. It's better for young people to go out and have a career than to stay in Jiangcheng."

Lin Chuan didn't answer.

Wang Guifen continued: "Your cousin Lin Hai has been in Shanghai for several years and is familiar with the place. If you don't know the way well then, let him guide you. Shanghai is big and the consumption is high, so don't be fooled."

Lin Chuan glanced out the window.

The buildings in Lujiazui cast shadows on the glass.

"Okay."

Wang Guifen didn't stop.

"We are all one family, you're welcome. Your cousin is now established in Shanghai. He works in sales for foreign companies and his income is not bad."

Lin Chuan said: "It's pretty good."

After hanging up the phone, Lin Chuan sent the itinerary to Ye Zhiqiu.

"The day after tomorrow, I will pick you up in Hongqiao in the morning. My parents, uncle's family, five of them."
